= Artificial Intelligence in Education =

⸻

== Introduction ==

Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to computer systems that can perform tasks requiring human intelligence. In education, AI is becoming an important tool for improving teaching methods and helping students learn more effectively. Many schools and universities use AI technologies in online learning, language learning, and educational applications.

⸻

== History ==

The idea of using [[artificial intelligence]] in education started in the late twentieth century. Early educational software provided simple exercises and automated feedback. Today, AI systems can analyze student performance, personalize lessons, and support teachers in classrooms.

⸻

== Uses of AI in Education ==

=== Personalized Learning ===

AI allows students to learn at their own speed and according to their individual needs.

=== Online Learning Platforms ===

Educational websites and applications use AI to recommend lessons, quizzes, and study materials.

Language Learning

Applications such as Duolingo and translation tools use AI to help users improve their language skills.

Virtual Assistants

AI chatbots and virtual assistants can answer students’ questions and provide academic support.

⸻

[[File:AI-EDUCATION-PROJECT.jpg|center|500px|AI-EDUCATION PROJECT]]

———-
== Advantages ==

* Faster access to information
* Personalized learning experience
* Better student engagement
* Support for distance learning
* Improved communication between students and teachers

⸻

== Disadvantages ==

* Privacy and security concerns
* Dependence on technology
* Reduced human interaction
* High implementation costs

⸻

Impact on Students

Artificial intelligence has changed the way [[students]] study and access information. Students can now learn from anywhere and receive immediate feedback through educational platforms and AI tools.

⸻

== Future of AI in Education ==

Experts believe AI will continue to grow in [[education]]. Smart classrooms, virtual teachers, and advanced educational technologies may become more common in the future.

⸻

== References ==

1. Encyclopaedia Britannica – Artificial Intelligence
2. UNESCO – AI and Education
3. Wikipedia – Artificial Intelligence
4. Google for Education
5. Duolingo Official Website

'''Lil DG$IN 084''' is a Brazilian trapper and songwriter from the state of [[Rio Grande do Norte]]. He is best known for his unique musical style that blends traditional trap beats with satirical and humorous lyrical content. 

== Musical career ==
Lil DG$IN 084 entered the underground music scene by introducing a subgenre characterized as comedy trap. His tracks leverage high-energy trap production with funny, relatable, and everyday storytelling, distinct from the traditional themes of regional hip hop. 

=== "rip caneta bic" ===
He gained initial recognition with the release of his debut single, '''"rip caneta bic"''' (Rest in Peace, Bic Pen). Despite its upbeat trap production, the song is structurally a "sad song" that comically laments the tragic and premature loss of a [[Bic (company)|Bic ballpoint pen]]. The track resonated with listeners due to its dramatic existential tone applied to a trivial daily inconvenience, establishing his identity as a humor-driven artist.

= Artificial Intelligence in Education =

⸻

== Introduction ==

Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to computer systems that can perform tasks requiring human intelligence. In education, AI is becoming an important tool for improving teaching methods and helping students learn more effectively. Many schools and universities use AI technologies in online learning, language learning, and educational applications.

⸻

== History ==

The idea of using [[artificial intelligence]] in education started in the late twentieth century. Early educational software provided simple exercises and automated feedback. Today, AI systems can analyze student performance, personalize lessons, and support teachers in classrooms.

⸻

== Uses of AI in Education ==

=== Personalized Learning ===

AI allows students to learn at their own speed and according to their individual needs.

=== Online Learning Platforms ===

Educational websites and applications use AI to recommend lessons, quizzes, and study materials.

Language Learning

Applications such as Duolingo and translation tools use AI to help users improve their language skills.

Virtual Assistants

AI chatbots and virtual assistants can answer students’ questions and provide academic support.

⸻

== Advantages ==

* Faster access to information
* Personalized learning experience
* Better student engagement
* Support for distance learning
* Improved communication between students and teachers

⸻

== Disadvantages ==

* Privacy and security concerns
* Dependence on technology
* Reduced human interaction
* High implementation costs

⸻

Impact on Students

Artificial intelligence has changed the way [[students]] study and access information. Students can now learn from anywhere and receive immediate feedback through educational platforms and AI tools.

⸻

== Future of AI in Education ==

Experts believe AI will continue to grow in [[education]]. Smart classrooms, virtual teachers, and advanced educational technologies may become more common in the future.
